local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local ok,err=pcall(function() local PS=require(RS.Shared.PortScene) PS.build({portId='london',portName='london',level=5,shipId='galleon',hasShipyard=true,facilities={'palace','bank','guild','harbormaster'},storyCount=0,companions={}},function() end) end) workspace:SetAttribute('ShotFov',55) workspace:SetAttribute('ShotCF',CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-170,95,175),Vector3.new(-420,18,0),Vector3.new(0,1,0))) return tostring(ok)..tostring(err)

local f=workspace:FindFirstChild("PortScene") assert(f,"PALACE_SCENE_MISSING")
local main=f:FindFirstChild("RoyalPalace") assert(main,"PALACE_MISSING")
local prim,models,meshes=0,0,0
for _,o in f:GetChildren() do
 local p=o:IsA("Model") and o:GetPivot().Position or (o:IsA("BasePart") and o.Position)
 if p and p.X<-240 and p.X>-640 and math.abs(p.Z)<300 then
  if o:IsA("Model") then models+=1 for _,d in o:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA("MeshPart") then meshes+=1 end end
  elseif o:IsA("BasePart") and o.Transparency<0.5 and not o:IsA("MeshPart") and o.Size.Y>1.5 then prim+=1 end
 end
end
return string.format("PALACE_AUDIT port=%s style=%s culture=%s tier=%s primitiveParts=%d models=%d meshParts=%d","london",tostring(main:GetAttribute("RoyalStyle")),tostring(main:GetAttribute("RoyalCulture")),tostring(main:GetAttribute("RoyalTier")),prim,models,meshes)
